''See also: [[Benson's steel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Benson]]'s [[steel]], also known as [[Benson]]'s [[liquid steel]], is a potent and cold power that can be summoned or called upon by certain individuals. It manifests as an icy sensation flowing through the veins and can appear physically as [[chains]] that wrap around a user's limbs. This essence provides significant physical reinforcement, granting the user increased strength, protection against pain and impact, and enhanced speed. It can also be used to deflect projectiles or facilitate dramatic physical feats like jumping great distances. However, the power is finite; using it can lead to exhaustion, physical weakness, and a heavy sensation in the limbs once the essence is depleted. The [[steel]] is associated with [[Benson]], a [[skeleton]] made of shining silvery metal, and can be drawn from deep within his essence or basement. Users may choose to call the [[steel]] all at once for a massive surge of power, though this method exhausts the supply more rapidly.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Benson]]'s [[steel]] was among the powers [[Simon]] possessed during his initial encounter with [[Valin]]. [[Simon]] utilized this ability to brace himself against walls, experiencing the sensation of it flowing through his veins like an icy river. He was also able to exert force by pushing with the power. Later, it was revealed that [[Indirial]] could summon [[Benson]]'s [[steel]], and [[Kai]] eventually used the ability as well.}}
